name: Bareki
backstory: Bareki was once part of a group of thieves, alongside Aelis Siryasius and Sarin, who broke into Enver Gortash's office. In doing so, they discovered the secret plot of The Absolute and were hunted by Absolute Cultists until they fled into the sewers. Sarin believed that Aelis and Bareki would get them all caught by recklessly spending the treasure they stole from Gortash, so she decided to hide it - inadvertently fueling their paranoia and causing them to fear that she had been taken over by the Absolute. As a result, Bareki decapitated her and Aelis burned her until only her skeleton remained.
